# R package development with devtools, testthat and roxygen2

Curated by Skill Harbor — Simon P. Couch's R package development skill, published in Posit's official skills repo: the exact devtools command lines (`load_all`, filtered `test()`, `document()`, `check()`), code style (`air format`, the base pipe `|>`, `\()` one-liners), testing conventions (testthat snapshot tests for errors/warnings instead of `expect_error`, no bare `expect_true`), documentation rules (roxygen2 wrapped at 80 chars, pkgdown index kept in sync), and NEWS.md hygiene (user-facing bullets, alphabetical by function, issue references). Honest caveats: methodology only — it guides an agent working on an R package, it is nothing to execute standalone; needs an R environment with devtools, testthat and roxygen2 installed. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
